div.head: I Cn 4.2
div.ab: Mycel is seo halsung ⁊ mære is seo halgung þe deofla afyrsað ⁊ on fleame gebringeð, swa oft swa man fullað oððe husel halgað; ⁊ halige englas þær abutan hwearfiað ⁊ þa dæda beweardiað ⁊ þurh Godes mihta þam sacerdon fylstað, swa oft swa hi Criste deniað mid rihte.

Great is the exorcising and wonderful is the hallowing through which he drives away devils and puts them to flight, as often as he baptises anyone or hallows the Eucharist; and holy angels hover round there and protect these acts, and, through the power of God, help the priests as often as they serve Christ as they ought.

Mycel is seo halsung ⁊ mære is seo halgung, þe deofla afyrsað ⁊ on fleame gebringeð, swa oft swa man fullað oððe husel halgað; ⁊ halige englas þær abutan hwearfiað ⁊ þa dæda beweardiað ⁊ þurh Godes mihta þam sacerdon fylstað, swa oft swa hig Criste deniað mid rihte.
